lede: Oklahoma carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.8 against +3.6, a 7.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma -6.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Oklahoma winning 67% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Oklahoma leads Kentucky by 135 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
